edits.descriptionKo: 가장 위쪽 분홍 꽃이 노란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the uppermost pink blossom near x70 y12 to vivid yellow, retaining all petal brushstrokes.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 꽃 한 송이가 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the middle-right pink flower around x70 y24 to cobalt blue, preserving its center.

edits.descriptionKo: 꽃 무리의 맨 아래 한 송이가 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the lowest pale pink blossom around x67 y28 and replace it with matching dark foliage behind it.

edits.descriptionKo: 화분 왼쪽의 큰 잎이 노란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Turn the large lower-left lobed leaf near x53 y44 from green to golden yellow; preserve its exact contour and veins.

edits.descriptionKo: 화분 앞면의 밝은 부분이 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the pale exposed front-left band of the flowerpot near x67 y56 to blue, keeping its edge and shading.

edits.descriptionKo: 맨 왼쪽 앞의 붉은 사과가 초록색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the large red apple at the far-left front around x13 y71 to green, retaining its dark stem dimple and shape.

edits.descriptionKo: 뒤쪽 천 위의 작은 사과가 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the small yellow-green apple behind the cloth at x44 y58 and restore the adjacent turquoise wall and cloth edge.
Remove the small horizontal yellow fruit on the lower-left-center cloth near x32 y82 and paint matching white folds.

edits.descriptionKo: 아래쪽 가운데의 큰 붉은 사과가 초록색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the large red apple in the lower-center-right at x62 y79 to green, keeping its size and texture.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 끝의 작은 사과가 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the small orange apple at the right edge near x82 y76 to blue, preserving its silhouette and shadow.
